// The `math` module: its own functions, and the `sym` symbols a maths-mode name reaches.
str(type(math))
repr(math.alpha)
repr(math.pi)
math.arrow
math.arrow.r.double
math.chevron.l
math.sum
math.dots.h
type(math.equation)
type(math.frac)
type(math.vec)
math.equation.where(block: true)
repr(math.mat)
!math.sym
!math.nothing_here
// A call in maths mode: a function, a symbol that is an accent or a delimiter, anything else.
repr($ sqrt(x) $)
repr($ root(3, x) $)
repr($ vec(a, b) $)
repr($ mat(1, 2; 3, 4) $)
repr($ mat(delim: "[", 1, 2; 3, 4) $)
repr($ mat(1, delim: "[", 2; 3, 4) $)
repr($ frac(a, b) $)
repr($ binom(n, k, m) $)
repr($ cases(a "if" b, c) $)
repr($ hat(x) $)
repr($ arrow(v) $)
repr($ floor(x) $)
repr($ abs(x) $)
repr($ lr(( x )) $)
repr($ f(x) $)
repr($ alpha(x, y) $)
repr($ sin(x) $)
repr($ lim(a; b) $)
repr($ arrow.r $)
repr($ arrow.r.double(x) $)
repr($ vec(..#(([a], [b]))) $)
repr($ f'(x) + g''(x) $)
repr($ x^2_i' $)
!$ frac(a) $
!$ foo(x) $
!$ alpha(x: 1) $
!$ alpha(..x) $
!$ arrow.nothing $
// The elements a call builds, with their fields as Typst stores them.
repr($ frac(a, b, style: "skewed") $)
repr($ cancel(x, angle: #45deg, length: #50%) $)
repr($ accent(a, "^", size: #50%) $)
repr($ accent(a, arrow) $)
repr($ overline(x) + underline(y) + overbrace(x, "t") + underbracket(y) $)
repr($ attach(a, tl: 1, tr: 2, t: 3, b: 4, bl: 5, br: 6) $)
repr($ scripts(sum) + limits(lim) $)
repr($ stretch(arrow.r, size: #200%) $)
repr($ op("x", limits: #true) $)
repr($ class("relation", x) $)
repr($ cases(delim: "[", a, b) $)
repr($ cases(reverse: #true, a, b) $)
repr($ vec(delim: #none, a, b) $)
repr($ mat(delim: #("[", none), 1; 2) $)
repr($ bold(x) + upright(y) + italic(z) + cal(A) + scr(B) + frak(C) + mono(D) + bb(E) + sans(F) + serif(G) $)
repr($ display(x) + inline(y) + script(z) + sscript(w) $)
repr($ round(x) + abs(x) + norm(y) + ceil(z) $)
repr($ lr(a + b, size: #50%) $)
repr($ mat(augment: #1, 1, 2; 3, 4) $)
repr($ mat(augment: #(vline: 1, stroke: red), 1, 2; 3, 4) $)
repr($ mat(gap: #2pt, 1, 2; 3, 4) $)
repr($ vec(gap: #2pt, align: #left, a, b) $)
